note: THE SOURCE for the company's site. Every fact the site states about the company is said here, once. What it states about the product - the version, the commands it names - is the engine's, read from the release requirements-engine.txt pins, and never typed here. A null is a fact not decided yet: the page leaves out what depends on it. The demo and the questions beside it are an illustration - a made-up company's plan and the assets that state it - and the page says so; `{name}` in a line is a value the generator fills from beside it, so no number is said twice.

why.heading: Why “Wherefore”
why.juliet: Juliet wasn’t asking where Romeo was. She was asking why he had to be who he was.
why.rule: In a Wherefore repository every file has to answer her: generated from a source, written by a person for a stated reason, or captured and stamped with what it was made from. A file that cannot answer stops the change.

asks.name: {after} seats
asks.because: Teams of four and five kept hitting the limit. The reason was written down with the change, so it ships with it.

asks.name: website
asks.because: Every line of me is built from the source. Nobody typed me, so nobody can make me disagree with it.

asks.name: slide 7
asks.because: I read the same plans and claims as the website, so the slide and the site cannot drift apart.

asks.name: orange
asks.because: The accent is said once. Every page, slide and social card is built from it, so a rebrand is one line.

asks.name: “SOC 2 certified”
asks.because: I am not allowed yet. Until the audit is signed, the most any page may say is “SOC 2 in progress”, and the check refuses the rest.

why.own: This site’s own answers are on its brand page.

how.heading: It installs in your repo, beside your code.

steps.label: your sources
steps.name: Write it once.
steps.text: Prices, plans, specs and claims live in one source, each with its reason.

steps.name: Compile everything.
steps.text: Every asset is generated from the source, the same way every time. Nothing in the build calls a model.

steps.name: Refuse the drift.
steps.text: On every push, anything stale or unaccounted for stops the change, and the error says why.

how.note: A command line, Python's standard library, and one file that says what your corpus is.

rule.client: Already compiling a hardware company: Chaotic Pendulums, where one spec file makes every drawing, solid model, parts list and web page. Move a dimension and every one of them moves with it, or the build stops and names the file that did not.

pilot.heading: Find out how often you contradict yourself.
pilot.text: The founder pilot starts with a count: every place your company states its pricing, and how many disagree. Then we compile them from one source, and keep them that way.
pilot.closed: Wherefore is in private development, and the pilot is not open yet.
